in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है James
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jimmy एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। James, the Hebrew name that means 'supplanter' or 'reformer', is an Anglicized form of the Hebrew name 'Ya'akov', which is derived from 'Akab' (heel) and 'Ya' (God). In the Bible, James was a brother of Jesus and one of the twelve apostles.
